snippet.title: Hollowed Oath Teaser
snippet.description:
Hollowed Oath's Teaser Video, now on Steam! 

Learn more at https://hollowedoath.com/

Wishlist Hollowed Oath on Steam today!

Join us in Discord at https://discord.gg/hollowedoath

Hollowed Oath is a heroic fantasy MMORPG set in the beautiful yet fractured world of Orrathis, where a mysterious force known as the Hollow distorts reality. The gods have vanished and civilization clings to survival behind wards, houses, and relics as twisted creatures, rival factions, and echoes of a forgotten past threaten what remains.

We believe you have the strength to become an Oathsworn; one of the few powerful enough to stand between the world and its undoing.
